title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: GAR Cap. VII § IX — actual by reatus, corruption by inhesion
pass_a_gloss: GAR Cap. VII § IX: Adam's actual passes into all no less than corruption—corruption by inhesion, his sin by reatus and imputation.
pass_b_english: GAR. Adam's actual sin passes into all humans no less than corruption. Namely corruption by inhesion, Adam's sin by reatus and imputation.
source_text: GAR. Actuale peccatum Adae in homines omnes non minus transit quam corruptio. Nimirum corruptio inhaesione, peccatum Adae reatu & imputatione.

choices.choice: Actual by reatus; corruption by inhesion

notes: Cap. IX reatus densify section 497 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 322–323 tip).
